proceduralAndVoxelCatalog.name: Core .vox-authored placeables
proceduralAndVoxelCatalog.description: Legacy Biomes placeables are authored from voxel/source assets and exported as GLTF/icon assets for the placeable ECS system.

proceduralAndVoxelCatalog.name: Harthmere resident room decor placements
proceduralAndVoxelCatalog.description: NPC home rooms procedurally receive beds, storage, lights, tables, personal objects, and wall hangings from resident/slum decor arrays.

proceduralAndVoxelCatalog.name: Procedural jobs board kiosks
proceduralAndVoxelCatalog.description: Two jobs board kiosks are generated entirely from Three.js boxes/lights: Grove market and town market boards.

proceduralAndVoxelCatalog.name: Procedural quest object markers
proceduralAndVoxelCatalog.description: Quest-linked landmarks generate lightweight object meshes from boxes, cylinders, torus rings, flags, crates, ledgers, boards, paint pots, routes, material clusters, and active beacons.

proceduralAndVoxelCatalog.name: Player voxel building blueprints
proceduralAndVoxelCatalog.description: Player buildings are defined as solid voxel structures; GLTFs may decorate, but the authoritative building geometry is generated as voxel foundation/floor/walls/roof/stair/door pieces.

proceduralAndVoxelCatalog.name: Block-built service and town shells
proceduralAndVoxelCatalog.description: Town/service buildings are generated from 1m block wall and floor slab contracts with entrance clearances and story heights.

proceduralAndVoxelCatalog.name: Procedural voxel actors
proceduralAndVoxelCatalog.description: Townsperson and animal proxies can be generated from rounded voxel body/head/face/clothing primitives before or instead of GLTF attachments.

proceduralAndVoxelCatalog.name: Imported Harthmere voxel packs
proceduralAndVoxelCatalog.description: Imported voxel pack assets include mines, graveyard props, itch props, large trees, wild-west props, Kenney voxel pack files, and medieval voxel OBJ structures.
